scope: D09: WinUI 3 sidebar, native contextual commands and transitions
method: Read relevant upstream sample sections and official API documentation via web; no source code vendoring or new dependency.

references.finding: A mounted SplitView contains pane and content. IsPaneOpen controls the pane; the sample does not remove the entire control on close.
references.application: SettingsDrawer retains its SplitView and pane root. Inline mode is a local choice because the wallpaper is a sibling; the content is a dismiss surface rather than the photo.

references.finding: The collection item template attaches a native MenuFlyout through ContextFlyout.
references.application: PictureCommands builds native commands for photo surfaces and realized gallery containers. Recycled containers receive a fresh item-specific target.

references.finding: The framework provides entrance animation with configurable offsets and staggering.
references.application: Only view chrome and drawer content receive an 8 DIP entrance. Background images are prepared before view replacement and do not fade from an empty backdrop.

verificationBoundary: Current source patterns inspected; not a repository-wide review, upstream revision pin, frame-time benchmark or physical mouse end-to-end test. Product verification is recorded in docs/context/NOW.md.
